definitions.explanation: A feeling of being afraid of something.
The possibility that something undesirable might happen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a fear of failure.

examples.japanese: {恐|おそ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}→克服：02805_kokufuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}しかける→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel fear about talking to strangers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a risk of an earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a risk of power outages from the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk of heavy snow tomorrow, so please refrain from going out.

notes:
{恐|おそ}れ has two main uses: emotional fear (sense 1) and the risk/possibility of something bad (sense 2). Sense 2 is especially common in news and weather reports.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a risk of ～ (very common in news)
- {恐|おそ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor fear
- {恐|おそ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}→克服：02805_kokufuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to overcome fear
- {恐|おそ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel fear

SPECIAL EXPRESSION:
⟦{恐|おそ}れ{入|い}ります→恐れ入る：05914_osoreiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ is a very polite set phrase meaning "excuse me, but..." or "I'm sorry to trouble you, but..." It is unrelated to fear.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{恐|おそ}れる→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧: to fear (verb form)
- ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしい→恐ろしい：02338_osoroshii⟧: frightening, terrible
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧: fear, terror (stronger, more visceral)
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧: anxiety, worry (milder than {恐|おそ}れ)
